description: IMO Carbon Intensity Indicator (CII) of a ship and its A-E rating for every year 2023-2030 (MARPOL Annex VI regulation 28; IMO guidelines G1-G5). Give the ship type, its capacity (deadweight for cargo ships, gross tonnage for ro-ro, ro-pax and cruise ships), the distance sailed in the calendar year in nautical miles, and the fuel burned in tonnes per fuel. Returns attained, required and reference CII, the four rating boundaries, the rating for the requested year and every other year, whether a corrective action plan is due (with previous_ratings), and every IMO parameter used with its citation. Optional G5 corrections: voyage adjustments, electrical/boiler deductions, reefers, and ship-to-ship or shuttle tankers. Unknown fields, ship types and fuels are refused with an error naming the field. Not pinnable with as_of.

capacity.description: DWT for bulk, gas, tanker, container, gencargo, reefer, combination and lng; GT for vehicle, roro, ropax, ropax_hsc and cruise.

corrections.description: Optional G5 corrections (MEPC.355(78)): voyage_fuel_t, voyage_distance_nm, deductible_fuel_t, reefer_days, sfoc ("2s"|"4s"), tanker ("none"|"sts"|"shuttle"), sts_fuel_t, capacity_correction.

distance_nm.description: Distance sailed in the calendar year, nautical miles.

fuel.description: Fuel burned in the year: [{ "fuel": "hfo|lfo|mdo|lng|propane|butane|ethane|methanol|ethanol", "tonnes": <number> }], each fuel once.

gross_tonnage.description: Optional: GT, for the 5,000 GT applicability test when capacity is DWT.

previous_ratings.description: Optional: up to two ratings A-E, the year before "year" first, e.g. ["D","D"] (three Ds in a row require a corrective action plan).

ship_type.description: bulk carrier, gas carrier, tanker, container ship, general cargo ship, refrigerated cargo carrier, combination carrier, LNG carrier, vehicle carrier (ro-ro cargo), ro-ro cargo ship, ro-ro passenger ship, ro-pax high-speed craft (SOLAS ch. X), cruise passenger ship.

name: calculate_cii
